hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; inp=json.load(sys.stdin); path=inp.get(\"file_path\",\"\"); blocked=[\".env\",\".env.local\",\".env.production\",\"MASTER-UNIVERSAL-ENV\"]; [exit(1) if b in path else None for b in blocked]" 2>/dev/null || (echo "BLOCKED: protected file" && exit 1)'

bash -c 'f=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) cd /mnt/c/antigravity && npx --yes prettier@3 --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac'
